module: Editor API for drag-and-drop of assets (file paths as strings) between ImGui windows. On initialization, adds to the editor instance: editor.dragDropAsset (internal state), editor.dragDropSource and editor.dragDropTarget. A source and a target match if they use the same dragDropId; the data is carried in a 2048-character buffer.
usage:
-- source
editor.dragDropSource("MyAsset", "/art/shapes/x.dae", function(str) end)
-- target
editor.dragDropTarget("MyAsset")
notes: dragDropTarget checks by assert that the payload size equals 2048; the callback registered by the source is called with the dropped string, then the state is reset.

In dragDropSource, the code uses `im.ArrayChar` and `im.ArraySize` while the local variable is called `imgui`: `im` is not defined in this file, which would cause an error if a global `im` does not exist (inferred from code).
Both functions are installed on the editor object, not on the module; only initialize is exported by the module.

initialize.desc: Initializes the module: stores the editor and installs dragDropAsset, dragDropSource and dragDropTarget on it.

editor.desc: Methods added to the editor instance by this module.

dragDropSource.desc: To be called while drawing the ImGui element that serves as the source: if a drag begins, creates the payload (data, 2048-character buffer), stores the callback and displays the text during the drag.

dragDropId.desc: Payload type identifier; targets only accept the same identifier.

callback.desc: Called with the string when the drop succeeded.

dragDropTarget.desc: To be called after the ImGui element that serves as the target: accepts a payload with the same dragDropId, calls the source's callback with the received string then resets the state.
